findings.reason: The protected app source and immutable native source use recursive descent without managing Python's default recursion limit. A legal 2,401-character expression with 1,200 balanced parenthesis pairs already raises RecursionError in the standalone runtime, and the deepest balanced expression permitted below the 10,000-character boundary has 4,999 pairs. The new visible trial-13 exposes this contract-boundary defect while both protected sources remain untouched.

The candidate preserves the accepted tokenizer, grammar functions, arithmetic data flow, and naming exactly, adding only a scoped recursion-limit guard derived conservatively from token count. It raises the limit only when necessary and restores the previous process value in a finally block. Names such as previous_recursion_limit and required_recursion_limit make the safeguard explicit, and no generic local named index appears.

Tokenization retains every integer, parenthesis, and arithmetic operator from the source-legal character set. parse_factor consumes signs and then one number or complete parenthesized expression; parse_term combines factors with multiplication or division; parse_expression combines terms with addition or subtraction. Immediate updates enforce left associativity, the call hierarchy enforces precedence, and signed absolute-value division truncates toward zero. The scoped recursion limit is at least three times the token count plus margin, covering the three parser frames added per nesting level, and restoration occurs after success or failure.

Metadata consistently identifies Premium LeetCode problem 772, Python, and the native calculate(s) interface. Fresh authenticated source evidence confirms a valid expression of length 1 through 10000 over non-negative integer literals, parentheses, and the four arithmetic operators; the allowed-character constraint does not include spaces. Integer division truncates toward zero, and every intermediate result remains in signed 32-bit range.

The protected app source and immutable native source bound to verified submission 2066058059 remain byte-unchanged and algorithmically identical. The candidate retains their exact regular-expression tokenizer, shared token position, three recursive grammar levels, repeated-sign handling, left-associative loops, parenthesis consumption, and signed integer division. Its only behavioral addition is standalone recursion-capacity management around the same parse call.

The former 8-, 32-, and 64-term tiers were proven under-calibrated: a correct O(n) iterative candidate fluctuated at the +0.15 threshold, while an honest O(n^2) remaining-token rebuild still passed. The recalibrated hidden tiers use 128, 512, and 2048 additive terms, contain only source-legal characters, reach length 4095, and span 16x. Across two repeated final runs, the protected parser passed at +0.00 and the candidate passed at +0.00 and +0.01 excess growth; the independently correct control that rebuilds and hashes the remaining token stream matched every output but failed only scaling at +0.29 and +0.26.

The Approach derives precedence from recursive parser levels, left-associative immediate evaluation, parenthesis recursion, and integer-only truncation toward zero. It now also derives the token-count recursion bound and explains guaranteed restoration. Its O(n) time and O(n) token-plus-recursion space claims match the candidate and branch manifest.

The modular Reference preserves the complete source narrative, valid-expression and signed-intermediate guarantees, conventional precedence and grouping semantics, truncation toward zero, the separate pre-example Note forbidding expression-evaluation built-ins, all three source examples in order without invented explanations, and all three constraint items. It correctly omits spaces from the permitted character set.

Fresh authenticated review on 2026-08-04 verified exactly three unexplained examples in source order, three constraint items, the non-negative-integer/operator/parenthesis grammar, truncation toward zero, valid-expression and signed 32-bit intermediate guarantees, and the separate Note prohibiting expression-evaluation built-ins. The statement has no images, tables, hints, or follow-up. source_fidelity.json binds live description-content hash cbb8e3c320532dafe04aec10d0e2a1576afe2a5913e4f8f649686b3b094b967e and every composed Reference section hash, and the repository validator reports verified with no errors.

coverage: The authenticated Premium statement contains exactly three examples, all without explanations. Their exact no-space inputs and outputs remain first in source order; the formerly mislabeled fourth official expression remains a separately labelled trial.

All sixteen ordinary correctness cases are visible samples or trials. Legal binary constructions cover negative dividends, negative divisors, negative intermediate values, and subtraction of a negative parenthesized result without relying on unstated unary syntax.

Contract boundaries cover lengths 1 and exactly 10000, zero, signed 32-bit result endpoints, and the 9999-character deepest balanced expression with 4999 parenthesis pairs. The new nesting case returns 1 with the candidate and independently reproduces RecursionError in both protected standalone implementations.

Material behavior covers all four operators, precedence, left associativity, nested parentheses, zero, negative intermediates, truncation toward zero with either operand negative, repeated signs retained by the accepted parser, and restoration of process recursion state.

Expected values were computed with an independent manual-tokenizer and two-phase Reverse Polish Notation evaluator. It, the candidate, protected app source, and immutable native Solution agree on all applicable authored inputs, 48315 exhaustive flat legal expressions, 20547 exhaustive parenthesized legal expressions, and 5000 deterministic random legal expressions; only the intentional maximum-nesting case separates the candidate from the protected standalone forms.

The recalibrated 128-, 512-, and 2048-term additive workloads are hidden and performance-only in benchmark.json, use only the source-legal digit and plus characters, span 16x, pass both linear parsers, and make the correct quadratic remaining-token rebuild fail only the scaling verdict.
